body.heading: Where in the world is The Gambia?
paragraphs: The Gambia is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of The Gambia is Banjul.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in The Gambia is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of The Gambia is the Gambian dalasi.

body.heading: How big is The Gambia?
paragraphs: The Gambia covers about 11,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Djibouti.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Boat trips up the River Gambia pass mangroves full of birds to Kunta Kinteh Island, a small island fort with a powerful history families can learn about together.
Tiny Abuko packs in a whole jungle — monkeys, crocodiles and hundreds of bird species along shady forest paths, right near the coast's beach resorts.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find The Gambia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: The Gambia in one breath: a country in Western Africa, capital Banjul, where people speak English and pay with the Gambian dalasi.
